mathematics.assertion_tested: For seeds 30--34, the deterministic full-logit TRAIN anchors are constructed without mutating source state; KL(source || current) has a stopped source gradient, is stationary at equal outputs within 1e-6, and decreases under the tested changed-logit descent step.
mathematics.conventions: Categorical KL sums over all PACK actions per state and then averages source-trajectory states equally.
inputs: Pinned PACK Dual fixed-kernel adapt_4096 checkpoints for seeds 30--34
All 32 natural TRAIN starts per seed
